queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Biscuit %' AND publisher = 'Biscuit Project';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Biscuit %' AND publisher = 'Biscuit Project' AND version_compare(version, '2.2.3') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'biscuit.exe');
